data.title: Rebrand: Photoshop-by-teenage-engineering direction for BRANDING.md + demo

data.body: REVIEW (cold, fresh context): PASS with minor inline fixes. Verified against plan acceptance criteria: (1) Token parity — all 11 named tokens (--ground #D3D2CD, --plastic #E7E6E1, --key #F2F1EC, --key-border #C6C5BF, --key-shadow #B4B3AD, --charcoal #1B1B1A, --lcd-text #E8E6DF, --ink #232320, --label #8B8A85, --orange #FF4E00, --paper #FBFAF8) match exactly between BRANDING.md and demo; 22px dot grid rgba(35,35,32,.13), LED glow rgba(255,78,0,.9), key-press mechanics (translateY(2px)+shadow collapse, 0 2px 0 shadow, 5px radius), 2px orange focus rings offset 2px, and all 16 drawing chips incl. the 11 hexes named in the doc — all match. (2) No old-identity remnants: grep for #CDC7BE/#12A594/#E93D82/#FFC53D/#0B4F48/Tahoma/raised/sunken bevels/'96 clean in both files (sole '96 hit is BRANDING's intentional retirement note). (3) JS passes node --check. (4) DOM wiring: all 12 getElementById + 4 querySelectorAll targets exist; st-x/st-y in place; zero old m-* menu ids. (5) Logic spot-checked: symmetry transforms correct (sym=8 = 4 rotations x mirror, det -1 reflections about center), flood fill bounds-guarded and applied at all symmetric click images, undo capped at 30, pointer scaling via bounding rect, shape preview snapshot/restore sound, export -> pattern.png. (6) Self-contained: no external http(s)/link/import. (7) Explicit backgrounds throughout; no horizontal overflow at 720px (column panel, wrapping deck, nowrap+hidden LCD). (8) Brand read: single orange accent in chrome, lowercase mono labels, PM-1 with en dash (5 uses, 0 hyphens), LEDs, LCD strip — unmistakably TE. INLINE FIXES (trivial): inactive tool LED #C9C8C2 -> var(--key-border) per BRANDING sec5; power-dot glow 0 0 6px .8 -> canonical 0 0 5px .9; body height:100% -> min-height:100% (flex-centering clipped device top on short viewports); BRANDING sec3 gains a one-line carve-out for the screw shading + custom-color spectrum ring (doc/demo disagreement resolved doc-side per sec11). Meets all acceptance criteria. Moving to done. NOTE: demo file modified — artifact needs republish.
